_about: App notification and Lock Screen copy (Round 2). Placeholders in {braces} are filled by the app. Spaced hyphens only, no exclamation points, no prices. Notifications are local, opt-in, at most one every min_days_between days, only between window_start_hour and window_end_hour on the phone's clock.

ask.button: Tell me when a new walk opens
ask.line: A note when a new walk opens, a seasonal pick now and then, and one reminder if you stop mid-walk. One a week at most, never at night.
